name: mirage
text: Correction first: I said the wallet was empty, and that was stale. It reads $136.57 now, so ignore that part. Why it was off: your phone (device 711) wrote the engine switch OFF at 2:57 PM ET yesterday, and the keeper obeys the phone's switch by design. The last engine run ended about 3:08 PM, and the scheduled checks after that just saw 'off' and started nothing. You switched it on at 7:24 PM and a runner started within about a minute. So it wasn't a crash, and nothing restarted it because the switch said off. I can't tell from the repo what caused the phone to write OFF (a tap, or a phone-side pause). If you didn't tap it, tell me and I'll dig into that path. I'd also change it so the engine can't be left off for hours without a message to you; say so and I'll build it.
